scope: actual built supplier status reader plus actual ModuleHost projection in isolated VM; no browser or provider writes

tests.name: projects existing professional task IDs separately from scene IDs with no writes
keeps only exact owned tasks and never matches by task or tenant name
uses the original supplier raw-status mapping rather than stale display labels
does not arrange running, completed, auto-start or disabled tasks
links explicit scene IDs and remote task keys only when uniquely verified
requires at least a compatible same-provider scene and respects explicit category facts
duplicate professional task identity fails closed instead of choosing a first row
configuration status change changes the captured target fingerprint
revoked module usage or unavailable saved configuration cannot disclose a directory
stale frame identity and unresolved explicit scene linkage fail closed
